response.query: How does memory-bank size scale with video length and resolution across scales; what are worst-case and expected GPU/CPU footprints and a formula for retrieval latency vs memory size and top-k?
response.answer: Memory-bank size scales with video length and resolution; GPU/CPU footprints grow with larger memory banks. Retrieval latency increases with memory size and depends on top-k retrieval algorithms. Larger memory banks typically require more processing power.
